author: potuz
content: I think what you guys want becomes effectively impossible. Suppose I get a bid for parent instead of head, and the head was built by the sabe builder. Then the balance would not cover it for the head state, but it will for the parent since without applying the head state the balance will be different. So to actually verify the bid correctly I would have to load the parent state instead of the head state. Which means I **will never ever** let a bid for the parent block, which is something you guys wanted to start with.
